$comment: Admin file for the network-restricted deployment (ADR-0005). node scripts/admin/new-gateway-config.mjs --topology private renders config/gateway.azure-private.yaml from it; pwsh -File infra/azure-private/Deploy-Gateway.ps1 -Step app deploys that file. deployment.developerCidrs: the networks developers connect from, which become access_control.allow_cidrs; the sign-in limits are per client address for each 10 minutes; storeConnectionsPerReplica is store.max_connections; desktop opts every policy in to Claude Desktop; telemetry sends client metrics to the OpenTelemetry Collector sidecar, which exports them to Application Insights (ADR-0007).
